examples.sql: SELECT Name,Age,AVG(Age) AS AvgAge FROM Sample.Person HAVING Age > AVG(Age) ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name,Age,AVG(Age) AS AvgAge FROM Sample.Person HAVING Age > 65 ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name,Age,AVG(Age) AS AvgAge FROM Sample.Person WHERE Age > 65 ORDER BY Age
SELECT AVG(Age) FROM Sample.Person HAVING COUNT(*)>99
SELECT AVG(Age) FROM Sample.Person HAVING %ID<10
SELECT AVG(Age) FROM Sample.Person WHERE %ID<10
SELECT Name, Age FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY Age HAVING Age < 21 ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name, Age FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY Age HAVING Age BETWEEN 18 AND 35 ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name, Home_State FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY Home_State HAVING Home_State IN ('ME','NH','VT','MA','RI','CT')
SELECT Name,DOB FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY DOB HAVING DOB IN ({d '1951-02-02'},{d '1987-02-28'})
SELECT Name,DOB FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY DOB HAVING DOB IN ({ts '1951-02-02 02:37:00'},{ts '1987-02-28 16:58:10'})
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person HAVING 'Red' %INLIST FavoriteColors
SELECT Name,Home_State FROM Sample.Person HAVING Home_State %INLIST $LISTBUILD("VT","NH","ME")
SELECT Name,Home_State FROM Sample.Person HAVING Name IN (SELECT Name FROM Sample.Employee HAVING Salary < 50000)
SELECT Name,Age FROM Sample.Person WHERE Age > 30 HAVING Name %STARTSWITH 'S' ORDER BY Name
SELECT Name,Age FROM Sample.Person HAVING FOR SOME (Sample.Person)(Age>20) ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name, FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person HAVING FavoriteColors IS NULL
SELECT Name, FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person HAVING FavoriteColors IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FavoriteColors
SELECT Name, FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY FavoriteColors HAVING FavoriteColors IS NOT NULL ORDER BY FavoriteColors
SELECT t1.disease FROM illness_tab t1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT t2.disease FROM disease_registry t2 WHERE t1.disease = t2.disease HAVING COUNT(t2.disease) > 100)
SELECT Home_State, MIN(Age) AS Youngest, AVG(Age) AS AvgAge, MAX(Age) AS Oldest FROM Sample.Person GROUP BY Home_State HAVING Age < 21 ORDER BY Youngest
SELECT field FROM table GROUP BY field HAVING condition-expression SELECT aggregatefunc(field %AFTERHAVING) FROM table [GROUP BY field] HAVING condition-expression
